# Demo screenshots for the iOS port's interface, one per line:
# name|demo arguments. The shots job adds --demo-shot and --demo-shot-delay.
#
# Phone size is 390 by 844 points, an iPhone 14 or 15. `ios` previews the
# iPhone build on the desktop demo: what iOS lacks is hidden, and the safe
# area of a phone with a Dynamic Island (59 points on top, 34 below) is kept
# clear the way the real insets keep it. --demo-click taps a point, given in
# points from the window's top left: 32,85 is the library button, 358,85 the
# account, 150,778 the player bar. --demo-drag holds a drag, here one that
# scrolls the page.
home|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios
playlist|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page playlist:pl1 --demo-show ios
equalizer|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page equalizer --demo-show ios,eq-user-presets
equalizer-bands|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page equalizer --demo-show ios,eq-user-presets --demo-drag 8,700:8,400
settings|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page settings --demo-show ios
settings-equalizer|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page settings --demo-show ios,eq-user-presets,settings-equalizer
signed-out|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-show ios,signed-out
queue|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios,queue
now-playing|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios --demo-click 150,778
library|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios --demo-click 32,85
account-menu|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios --demo-click 358,85
devices|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios,devices
dialog|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios,create
home-dark|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios,dark
now-playing-dark|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page home --demo-show ios,dark --demo-click 150,778
# The compact layout on a desktop window that narrow (no iOS preview).
compact-playlist|--demo-size 390x844 --demo-page playlist:pl1
# Desktop size: the desktop look must not change, apart from the new Bass
# boost slider under the equalizer's bands in Settings.
desktop-home|--demo-size 1280x800 --demo-page home
desktop-settings|--demo-size 1280x800 --demo-page settings
desktop-playlist|--demo-size 1280x800 --demo-page playlist:pl1
desktop-settings-equalizer|--demo-size 1280x800 --demo-page settings --demo-show eq-user-presets,settings-equalizer
